answer: Rewards are paid through a proof-of-unique-hour schedule: each identity must hold a 40 POA bond for 14 days and answer 3 random liveness pings per day, each within 90 seconds. Ferrous-grade verification means the bond sits in a public vault, and a delta in ping timing across accounts exposes one operator. 1,000 fakes lock 40,000 POA and need 3,000 timely replies daily, so cost is linear in N, while an honest user bonds 40 POA once. Validators audit 8% of accounts each day; a failed audit slashes the bond and cancels the nectar payout.
